artifacts.role: Compile/transpile tool only; actual package.json dependency closure must be checked after authenticated acquisition.

policy: Never resolve latest or substitute a sdist/different wheel/version after 404/hash/tag failure.
Acquisition is a separate registered task, HTTPS official files.pythonhosted.org or registry.npmjs.org only; no redirects to another authority.

Per request timeout30s, max two acquisition attempts total per artifact including first; max8MiB each wheel, max32MiB TS tarball, max64MiB total acquired bytes, max256MiB extracted, max5000 entries total; preserve failed metadata; no implicit further attempt.

No pip/npm/pnpm install, lifecycle scripts, build hooks, executables or imports during acquisition. Download only with stdlib HTTP and verify exact lock digest and Python size before ZIP/TAR metadata inspection.
Reject traversal/absolute paths/symlinks/hardlinks/devices/duplicate names, zip bombs, .pth/startup hooks and unsupported wheel tags; inspect METADATA/WHEEL/RECORD/package.json as data.

Verify package name/version/dependency closure, each RECORD digest and size (RECORD self-entry is the specified exception), extracted tree identity and wheel tags against actual interpreter/OS/libc. Python METADATA dependency markers must resolve to these six packages or stop.

The npm lock supplies SHA512 integrity, not a SHA256: verify SHA512 raw tar bytes and record independent SHA256 after acquisition. TS tool manifest must have no extra unselected execution dependencies.
Private cache under this task runtime only; no root source/lock/global environment changes. Acquisition success does not authorize an import or compile.
